quote: pay all invoices within ninety days
comment: Ninety-day payment terms are three times our standard. Ask for thirty days.

quote: unlimited liability for any loss arising from the services
comment: Unlimited liability is not acceptable. Cap it at the fees paid in the preceding twelve months.

quote: transferred to any country where the supplier operates
comment: This allows transfers with no safeguards. Name the countries and the transfer mechanism.

quote: renews automatically unless either party gives notice
comment: Auto-renewal with no notice window. State how many days before the term ends notice is due.

quote: laws of the State of Delaware
comment: Confirm Delaware is acceptable; our other agreements use the courts of the customer's seat.
